about: How easy mode's P describes this kit to an image generator (engine/imageprompt.gd). tail: the kit's style line. styles: a different line for a room style. looks: what a model is, by id ({name, look, class}; class is wall, mounted, floor, centrepiece or corner). tag: the kit's id prefix.
tail: ruined far-future industrial sci-fi, off-white chamfered composite panels on a near-black frame, gunmetal trim, burnt orange and teal accents, hazard-yellow chevrons, thin cyan and amber light strips, exposed cables and copper pipe, grimy and scuffed, a few rust streaks

ht_chair_ops.name: Operator's Chair
ht_chair_ops.look: high-backed, on a floor rail, with harness straps and one armrest console

terminal_wall.name: Wall Terminal
terminal_wall.look: a console against the wall with a tilted screen over an angled keyboard slab, a cable running down to the floor and a small red beacon on a mast

terminal_desk.name: Terminal Desk
terminal_desk.look: a console on a single pedestal with an angled key deck and a curved bank of three screens, one of them dead

reactor.name: Reactor Column
reactor.look: a floor-to-ceiling column with a glowing violet core in a glass cylinder, copper and steel rods round it and three chrome rings turning round the core

fabricator.name: Fabricator
fabricator.look: a boxy industrial 3D printer with a glowing cyan print bed, a print head on a chrome gantry and something gold half-printed on the bed

health_station.name: Health Station
health_station.look: a wall unit with a glowing green cross and a tray of three green vials

cache.name: Supply Cache
cache.look: a low armoured chest with orange end bands, a lock plate, amber light inside and a hinged lid

crate.name: Cargo Crate
crate.look: a one-metre cube with metal corner posts, a teal band round the middle and a hazard label plate

barrel.name: Barrel
barrel.look: a ribbed orange drum with a glowing red band and a hazard label

server_rack.name: Server Rack
server_rack.look: a tall black cabinet of server blades with rows of tiny status lights, a teal cap and a cable running up to the ceiling

cryo_pod.name: Cryo Pod
cryo_pod.look: a tall glass cylinder between heavy black caps, a pale fleshy specimen with trailing tendrils floating inside, a green-lit base

cryo_pod_broken.name: Broken Cryo Pod
cryo_pod_broken.look: the base of a cryo pod with jagged glass shards standing round it and slime spilled across the floor

holo_table.name: Holo Table
holo_table.look: a round console table on a pedestal with a glowing cyan top projecting a slowly turning glass hologram ringed with cyan and pink light

debris.name: Debris
debris.look: a low heap of fallen panels, rusted plates, cables and copper pipe you can step over

nest.name: Nest
nest.look: an organic nest: a low mound of flesh with pale egg sacs and slime, tendrils spreading across the floor

pillar.name: Pillar
pillar.look: a turned structural column with a glowing cyan core behind metal ribs and copper rings

locker.name: Supply Locker
locker.look: a tall metal locker with a louvred door, a teal cap and a lock light

locker_bad.name: Rusted Locker
locker_bad.look: a tall rusted metal locker with a dented, louvred door pushed out from inside and something leaking from under it

arch_medical.name: Medical Scanner Arch
arch_medical.look: a free-standing walk-through scanner arch with a light bar across the opening and a green light

arch_security.name: Security Scanner Arch
arch_security.look: a free-standing walk-through scanner arch with a light bar across the opening and a red light

arch_supply.name: Supply Scanner Arch
arch_supply.look: a free-standing walk-through scanner arch with a light bar across the opening and a cyan light

arch_toll.name: Toll Scanner Arch
arch_toll.look: a free-standing walk-through scanner arch with a light bar across the opening

trap_laser.name: Laser Tripwire Emitter
trap_laser.look: a small dark box with a lens that shines a red beam, a hazard stripe across it

trap_shock.name: Shock Floor
trap_shock.look: a square floor plate of copper tiles with glowing cyan studs, edged in hazard yellow

trap_vent.name: Gas Vent
trap_vent.look: a round floor vent with a hazard-yellow ring, radial slats and a copper nozzle

window_obs.name: Observation Window
window_obs.look: a wide pane at eye height in a heavy frame; it does not open
